attempts.error_analysis: S5 = A (4/4): All inverse function, logarithm, and exponential equation problems correct. Solid command of log undefined conditions, inverse notation, and solving exponential equations with logs. S6 = B (3/4): Strong across modeling — pool fill, SAAB recovery, and Yard Sale optimization all correct. Three of four Bellevue parts credited. One identified error: Bellevue part (d) — deriving growth rate from 2020 census. Should solve 151,654 = 122,363·b^10 → b = 1.2394^0.1 ≈ 1.0217 (2.17%/yr). Kai's computed rate came in lower (~1.1%/yr), likely a calculator keying error when evaluating the 10th root (possibly entered 10 instead of 0.1 as the exponent, or used wrong operation). Concept is correct; execution failed.
